observations.name: Beetroot Capsules one-time variant
observations.reference_price_note: Specific selected variant app metadata compareAtPrice=4499 alongside price=2999; a reference price, not a separately observed sale.

availability_evidence: Add to cart product submit button present without disabled attribute
product_observations.availability_caveat: App inventory quantity and continue-policy fields are not evidence of actual warehouse stock or sales. No checkout was tested.

excluded_cross_product_prices: Cart upsell Moringa Capsules $24.99/$44.99 is a different product; do not attach its current price to Beetroot.

Generic subscription widget defaults must not override the variant-specific monthly 10% selling plan.

learning_notes.observation: The official page sells a 30-day routine with small daily tasks, weekly video and two named bonuses, then offers a higher-price three-eBook upgrade.
learning_notes.permitted_use: Article/Factory learning can describe offer packaging and CTA structure as observed; do not claim this causes sales or repeat medical-effect claims as facts.

learning_notes.observation: One selected physical-product variant has both a one-time price and an explicit monthly 10%-off subscription plan.
learning_notes.permitted_use: Keep product, variant and billing cadence in the database rather than mixing a cart upsell with the main offer.

learning_notes.observation: The guide lists daily exercises and bonuses, but the page contains conflicting availability signals.
learning_notes.permitted_use: Explain the offer and observed CTA while leaving payment/stock outcome unknown.
